text.description_html:
MNG 18126, Bling Cabinet T-Knob in Polished Chrome

The Bellagio Crystal Polished Chrome Long Knob is a glam girl's dream come true. If you want to add a little sparkle to your kitchen cabinets or add crystal to your dresser drawers, the Crystal Bellagio Long Knob in Polished Chrome will add the extra bling you are looking for. These pretty cabinet knobs will give your room new life. Each knob is individually packaged with 2 different sized screws.

This cabinet knob is part of the MNG Bellagio Collection.

Specifications and Features of the MNG 18126 Crystal Bellagio Long Knob in Polished Chrome:

  • Base Material: Zinc / Crystal
  • Finish: Polished Chrome
  • Length: 2-1/2"
  • Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screw and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screw.

Sold Individually
